note: Re-judged 2026-10-16: the unit moved verbatim to core, with only the family identifier renamed. RFC 8955 Section 8: "The NLRI length field shall include both the 8 octets of the Route Distinguisher as well as the subsequent Flow Specification NLRI value." The positive requires Len() and the WriteTo length octet to equal 8 plus the value length; its first assertion checks the fixture against itself, and the WriteTo assertion is the real check. The negative requires ErrFlowSpecTruncated for the same RD and value under a length that counts only the value.
